name: agentic-framework
description: 21-agent execution framework for Claude Code: specialist routing, spec-driven build loops, an enforced peer-review quality gate (hooks included), and six bundled MCP servers — context7 (library docs; reads the optional CONTEXT7_API_KEY env var at launch), filesystem (MCP_FS_ROOT, defaults to the project directory), serena (pinned to v1.6.1 by commit SHA), sequential-thinking, fetch, code-review-graph (persistent incremental code knowledge graph for reviews; pinned to 2.3.8). All launchers are version-pinned so npx/uvx resolve from cache instead of the network at each session start. Run /agentic-framework:setup after install to configure optional environment variables.
